rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT calculations (geometry optimization, DOS) using PBE functional; requires building two crystallographic models (Pbam and P4/mbm) but no novel algorithmic development.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: generate two input structures, run two separate DFT relaxations with full cell optimization, compute DOS and band gap, then summarize and compute energy difference. Requires proper input file generation, code execution, and output parsing.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires standard DFT geometry optimizations and DOS calculations on two small crystal structures. The method is applying established PBE functional, not developing new theory; thus conceptual difficulty is moderate. Execution involves building structural models, running two optimizations, and comparing energies, which is a multi-step pipeline with tool orchestration, though straightforward. Computational resources are very low.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small unit cell (4 f.u.) with ~10-20 atoms, plane-wave DFT at 900 eV cutoff and 7x7x11 k-points, runs easily on a single CPU core in <1 GB RAM; no large datasets.
